settings.help: Keep repeated raw card-capture evidence for this many days. Older captures are deleted even when the canonical job identity is retained.
Archive stale neutral jobs after this many days since last seen. Archiving removes bulky current card text unless activity-preservation requires the rich row to remain.

After this many days since last seen, remove an unimportant archived job's detailed row and retain only a small tombstone identity so rediscovery is still recognised as previously seen. Must be greater than archive_after_days.
Never automatically archive/remove a detailed market job that has any per-user activity history. User activity stays in its own ledger and is not stored on the neutral job row.
Default source freshness horizon for market collection when a run does not explicitly supply one.
Initial SEEK navigation settling time before card-state polling begins.
Maximum bounded wait for a SEEK page to become a valid card page or explicit terminal page.
Runaway-loop protection only. Hitting this limit is a FAILED/incomplete run, never successful exhaustion.
Allowed shortfall between SEEK's first reported count and collected unique IDs before a leaf is marked incomplete. Small tolerance handles jobs appearing/disappearing during a live crawl.

Run role-keyword SEEK registry searches in addition to whole-state partition coverage. Off by default because whole-state NSW/ACT/QLD coverage already contains those SEEK jobs and repeated keyword searches add load without improving coverage.
Maximum SEEK-reported results allowed in one leaf partition before it must be split further. Default 450 keeps well below the approximate 500-result paging risk.
Initial LinkedIn navigation settling time before card-state polling begins.
Maximum bounded wait for a LinkedIn offset to expose parseable result cards.
Number of LinkedIn result offsets to process per resumable chunk. This bounds one agent call without limiting total market coverage.
Number of source/query combinations processed per campaign invocation. This is a resumable execution chunk, not a market-coverage limit.
Minimum evidence score for recording a non-destructive possible duplicate link between two separately sourced job rows.
Allow title/employer/location plus rich card evidence to create possible-duplicate links. Exact same-source IDs remain deterministic regardless of this setting.
Default number of jobs returned by feed/search endpoints when a consumer does not specify a limit.
Maximum jobs returned in a single API page to keep consumer calls bounded.
Local-only API listen port used by the start script. Change here rather than editing Python.
